channels.deleteWarn: Reminders will no longer be sent to this channel.
channels.label: Label
channels.noServices: No notification services are enabled on this server. Ask an administrator.
channels.urlKeep: Leave empty to keep the current URL. URLs are never shown again.
channels.urlHint: Where Gunkly sends the messages, written as a Shoutrrr service URL (for example ntfy://ntfy.sh/my-topic). For the common apps, pick them under Service instead: Gunkly then asks for what that app gives you and builds this for you. You can also paste a Discord, Slack or Google Chat webhook link here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.privacy: Reminder text (chore names and dates) is sent to the third-party service you choose, so only use services you trust.
svc.invalid: That doesn't look right for {name}. Check the values against the steps above.
svc.topicHint: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Anyone who knows the topic can read the messages, so make it hard to guess.
svc.chatHint: @name of a public channel, or the numeric chat ID of a group or person (for example -1001234567).
svc.ntfy.step1: Install the ntfy app (Android, iOS or ntfy.sh in the browser) and subscribe to a new topic with a name only you know, for example chores-a8f3k2.
svc.ntfy.step2: Enter the same topic below. Messages arrive in the app at once.
svc.ntfySelf.step1: In the ntfy app, add your own server and subscribe to a topic on it.
svc.discord.step1: In Discord, open the channel's settings (the gear), then Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook.
svc.discord.step2: Press Copy Webhook URL and paste it below.
svc.slack.step1: In Slack, add the Incoming Webhooks app to your workspace (or create an app with an incoming webhook) and choose the channel.
svc.slack.step2: Copy the webhook URL (it starts with https://hooks.slack.com/services/) and paste it below.
svc.googlechat.step1: In Google Chat, open the space, then Apps & integrations, Webhooks, Add webhook.
svc.googlechat.step2: Copy the webhook URL and paste it below.
svc.telegram.step1: In Telegram, start a chat with @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the steps. Copy the bot token it gives you.
svc.telegram.step2: Add your new bot to the group or channel that should get the messages (for a channel, as an admin), or send it a message yourself.
svc.telegram.step3: Enter the token and the chat below. How to find a group's numeric chat ID is in the full guide.
svc.pushover.step1: Sign in at pushover.net and copy your User Key from the top of the page.
svc.pushover.step2: Under Your Applications, create one (for example "Gunkly") and copy its API token.
svc.pushbullet.step1: At pushbullet.com, open Settings, Account and press Create Access Token. Copy it and paste it below.
